neighbours.label: A word in advice about taking part in an exchange, setting up input ('by asking', 'ask', 'by contributing', 'write a'); the same verbs in plain reports, and advice about other things, stay lower.
fire: Strong teams improve by asking hard questions in meetings.
Speak up in class and ask whenever you are unsure.
Readers can help by contributing to the comment thread.
Tell us your view and write a short review.
Good mentors learn by asking what people need.
Join the debate and ask the panel directly.
Fans can help by contributing ideas to the forum.
Share your thoughts and write a note to the editor.
quiet: Strong teams improve through lifting heavy weights in the gym.
Sit down in class and open your books.
Volunteers can help by painting the fence on Sunday.
He told me his name and wrote a short novel.
A clerk was asking the time at the station.
Join the queue and pay at the front desk.
The farm got by selling apples at the market.
She sat at home and wrote a letter to her aunt.

short: word in advice about giving input
notes: Second round. The first test (branch nightshift/claude-15/sweep7-20261105) failed because one pair shared the prefix through the peak ' leave'. It had 0.27-0.91 on fire sentences; 'left excellent tips' read 0.53, above 'gave excellent feedback', so I drop evaluative adjectives from the label. No new probing.
